scope: Independent source inspection, focused synthetic storage tests and one historical-receipt misattribution adversarial fixture; no final campaign database build or actual HH execution

commands.command: python -B stdin: import focused test fixture; copy prior/reused.json byte-for-byte to continuation/old_copied_as_current.json; replace ledger with one ACTUAL_NATIVE_INVOCATION referring to that copy; call builder in temporary output directory

after_owner_fix.reason: A historical receipt cannot count as a new native invocation

commands.command: Read-only SQLite metadata lookup: artifacts row for runtime/RANGE_TILE00_COMPLETION.json and prior_artifact_records sha256 column; SHA256 read of prior database

findings.problem: A byte-identical historical receipt copied into the continuation namespace could be counted as a new native invocation when omitted from the reused-record list. Current-ledger duplicate detection alone did not establish fresh execution attribution.
findings.owner_correction: Load all artifact hashes from pinned prior artifacts and inherited prior_artifact_records; reject new-invocation receipt hashes already present there. Require reused receipt path and SHA to be present in prior continuation artifact rows.
findings.independent_result: Copied historical receipt now rejected before output creation; focused suite passes.

source_review.prior_database: Pinned main-file SHA before and after; read-only SQLite connections; backup API copies prior state
source_review.inherited_schema_and_contents: Every inherited table plus schema objects is compared by canonical logical state after append
source_review.snapshot: Current regular-file inventory is checked again after SQL restore; evidence hashes and namespace paths checked; source changes or additions invalidate snapshot
source_review.accounting: Actual native invocation, reused accepted receipt and host-only event counts remain separate; source receipt fields and supplied counters are cross-checked; historical hashes cannot be promoted to current executions
source_review.restore: Local SQL dump restored into new SQLite; integrity and foreign-key checks plus complete logical state comparison
source_review.failure_behavior: Create-only output; generated database restricted outside source trees; failed output is inspectable and is not given successful verification receipt
source_review.proof_scope: Builder records source identities and declared receipt fields, explicitly delegates numerical validity to runner/reviewer evidence, and does not infer scientific or cloud-restore admission
